scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic, gives exact sharp equality witnesses, credits prior qualitative instability and classical metric inequalities; the finite code is consistency testing only.
scientific_limitations: Real SPD matrices; exact-arithmetic one-vector sketched FOM and squared-norm embeddings on span{b,Ab}; no higher-rank, error, or sampling guarantee. Earlier equivalent numerical-range bounds cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp one-vector sketching envelope and positive-stability threshold for symmetric systems
